engineeringCoreReady.title: Engineering core ready for downstream business implementation

deferred.reason: Formula engines are adapters behind the canonical calculation I/O and are not required to freeze the order or technical model.
DXF generation consumes geometry requests from a technical release package and may be implemented after the release interface is stable.

engineeringCoreReady.evidence: R-11 approves only the architecture contracts, destructive migration plan, phase-gate dependency, and first golden-sample scenarios. Runtime migration, calculation execution, release persistence, and signed golden results are still incomplete.

beforeSalesOrder.title: Before sales-order implementation

deferred.reason: Can wait until the current-context package and sales-order contract scope are stable.
Dependency-closure selection should be added after the first compact context workflow is proven.
Deep feature coverage checks need approved sales-order contract files first.
Dependency matrix visualization is deferred until sales-order/delivery/finance boundaries exist.
Requires approved API contracts and runtime fixtures.
Requires approved UI screens and browser acceptance path.

beforeSalesOrder.evidence: Business implementation remains blocked until required contract items are completed, including the aggregate engineering-core-ready item. R-11 does not complete that item. The phase-gate checker covers canonical sales-order roots, common naming variants, SQL table creation, Vue/API/menu/permission content, and bypass-capable RuoYi runtime roots.

beforeDelivery.title: Before delivery implementation
beforeDelivery.evidence: Delivery is deferred until sales-order state and shipment boundaries exist.

beforeFinance.title: Before finance implementation
beforeFinance.evidence: Finance is deferred until fund and receipt responsibilities are explicit.

beforeProduction.title: Before production implementation
beforeProduction.evidence: Production is deferred until payment and release policy are explicit.
